Class SubstringSearch

java.lang.Object
SubstringSearch
public final class SubstringSearch extends Object
Searches UTF-8 files using the Knuth-Morris-Pratt algorithm. Indices count Unicode code points, starting from zero.

    • find

      public static List<Long> find(String filename, String substring) throws IOException
      Finds all occurrences, including overlapping matches. Only the pattern, a fixed-size input buffer, and the results are stored.
      Parameters:
      filename - the file to search
      substring - the non-empty string to find
      Returns:
      the starting indices in ascending order
      Throws:
      IOException - if reading fails or the file contains invalid UTF-8
      IllegalArgumentException - if the substring is empty

    • find

      public static void find(String filename, String substring, LongConsumer onMatch) throws IOException
      Reports matches without storing them, using memory independent of file size.
      Parameters:
      filename - the file to search
      substring - the non-empty string to find
      onMatch - the action to perform for each starting index
      Throws:
      IOException - if reading fails or the file contains invalid UTF-8
      IllegalArgumentException - if the substring is empty
